description: Harmless local benchmark corpus for Unsus static and diff behavior. No real malware samples are included.

notes: Fixtures may contain lifecycle scripts as text, but the benchmark runner only scans and diffs them.
The fake secret name used by suspicious fixtures is FAKE_TEST_TOKEN.
Network examples use example.invalid and must not be contacted by the runner.

cases.why: A normal build postinstall that writes only a local marker if executed in a sandbox.
Network API usage in library code without install-time execution should not block by itself.
Install-time script plus fake credential access plus network API should block.
Obfuscation feeding dynamic code execution is a high-risk behavior chain.
New version adds an install script and suspicious install source.
Registry-like package adds suspicious files absent from the clean source-like package.
